note: T2A answering HTTP 200 with a non-transient base_resp status: MiniMax reports its own outcome even under 200, and 1004 is its documented code for a request it refuses as the caller's (the key). The adapter has set `answered` before this check, so the failure is a Spent — its lost call written (S-142) — and the class is RefusedRequest, so its run's kind is engine, not unreadable: a request that was wrong is wrong the second time (resume-failed, S-163). DOCUMENTED SHAPE: the same base_resp as the 401 fixture, under 200.
